My dearest, I don't say this enough, but every ordinary day feels a little more golden because you're in it. Thank you for your laugh, your patience, and the way you make even quiet Tuesdays feel like something worth remembering. Here's to another year of us, more inside jokes, more terrible movie nights, more of everything good. I love you more than this website can express (and I tried to make it express a lot).

xo, maddie
